Release v1.8.2a (2 April 2020) |previous_update = [[Release v1.7]] |next_update = [[Release v1.9|Egg Hunt 2020 Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.8''' was the twentieth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 4th of March 2020. It added the [[Templar]] enemy while also rebalancing various towers and enemies. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.8''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed four updates, the main Release v1.8.0 update (released 4 March 2020) and three minor updates, the Release v1.8.1 (released 18 March 2020), Release v1.8.1a (released 24 March 2020), Release v1.8.2 (released 1 April 2020) and Release v1.8.2a (released 2 April 2020). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *[[Templar]] ===Maps=== :In '''Release v1.8.1''': *[[Spring Fever]] ===Crates===
